title: @kahn
description: a Kahn network under @kahn: channels holding tokens and processes reading and writing them, compiled by kahn.jq to an open net; one reader and one writer per channel, and every name a process uses a channel, are checked by the compile

channels.description: each channel and the tokens it starts with, in order; a channel is a labeled place of the net

processes.description: each process by name: the target it runs and the channels it reads one token from and may write to; more join by the at line @<name>.proc

reads.description: the channels it takes one token from per firing

writes.description: the channels its target produces to itself

final.description: the token counts the network must end with, by channel; without it, the end is not checked
